ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; high-intensity pixels are limited to <5% of the total visible surface area, concentrated primarily at distal tips and linear scar sites against a dominant low-intensity (black) field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogenous low-intensity field across both lobes. High-intensity (white) clusters are localized at the extreme left and right distal vertices. A singular high-intensity diagonal linear feature is mapped to the upper-quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 102 degrees; depth is 12% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits low-amplitude peaks. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, irregular indentations and 'saw-tooth' excavations in the distal third section.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve beginning from the median notch, transitioning to a linear sweep toward the distal tips; terminal vertices are sharply defined and slightly upturned.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of roughly circular high-intensity pixel groups (3-12 pixels in diameter) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, unaligned diagonal high-intensity linear disruption on the left lobe surface; several shorter, faint parallel linear marks are detected on the right lobe distal to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe irregular tissue loss/notching on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe. Prominent diagonal white linear scar on the mid-left lobe.
